tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /glang nag bkra shis chos sdings dge 'dun rnams la gnang ba'i spyi 'gro bzhugs so// na mo gu ru sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa ya/ dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdung rabs las/ /dpal ldan mtshan mchog gsum mnga' sa skya pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma yi dam bstan srung gis/ /dpal ldan bkra shis chos gling dar brtan mdzod/ /ces 'dod pa'i don la shis pa brjod pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas ched du bya ba glang nag bkra shis chos sdings dge 'dun rnams sdom rgyun rnam par dag pa'i mkhan slob sa lugs bstan 'dzin rnams las nyes med phun tshogs kyi dge tshul dge slong gi bslab khrims nos shing gtsang ba'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi sger dang mthun pa'i thos bsam sgom pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs dgon de'i bca' yig sngon ma rnams kyis don bzhin bsgrigs lam kun spyod dge rgyun bcas dar rgyas 'byung ba bzhin tshang mas nges pa dang / khra rgyun skor sa dge khang sogs sngar yod la de khul rnams nas 'phrog pa dang bkag 'gog med pa zhig tshang mas nges pa dang / de bzhin sgrub pa rnams la dpal sa skya'i bstan srung rnams nas srung skyob mel tshe dang / de las 'gal ba rnams la tshar gcod mdzad pa sogs rgyu 'bras bden pa mngon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas las ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyi bla brang mthong smon phun tshogs gling nas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris shing lag rjes can du bgyis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ glang nag bkra shis chos sdings dge 'dun rnams la gnang ba'i spyi 'gro/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
